verdict.rationale: An IaC toolchain could plausibly ship built-in AI code generation, so this axis applies to OpenTofu. Nothing in the evidence shows any natural-language or AI-assisted code generation in OpenTofu's CLI or ecosystem. Its documented features are plan, test, import, state encryption, for_each providers and -exclude, none of which concern AI generation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate infrastructure code from natural language using AI assistance built into the toolchain
